property_summary: For any caller address A and candidate newOwner N, if A is the current owner then calling transferOwnership(N) succeeds and sets owner() == N; the mutant inverts the guard so an actual owner cannot transfer ownership, causing owner() to remain unchanged for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the require condition to require(msg.sender != owner), inverting the guard so only non-owners can call owner-only functions.
